title: The updated version is not available
author: JohnnyB-ro

judgment.rationale: The reported four-part-version parsing problem is covered by merged PR 49414, which changed src/common/version/helper.cpp and shipped before the current stable release.
evidence: The Store-installed 0.100.2 client does not offer 0.101.2362.0.
A discussion comment identifies the old three-part parser and EOF condition.
PR 49414 is merged and includes src/common/version/helper.cpp and UnitTestsVersionHelper.cpp changes.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as handled by the merged version-parsing work; retain a separate servicing follow-up only if a supported affected release still cannot update after Store propagation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The merged parser work directly covers four-component version handling.

issue_context.summary: A Store installation at 0.100.2 did not recognize an available four-component PowerToys release.
known_information: The reporter reproduced after reinstalling from the Microsoft Store.
The discussion identifies a parser limitation.
PR 49414 merged on 2026-08-06 and the cited release published on 2026-08-25.
inferences: The original binary's version parsing, rather than general Store health, is the likely update-detection boundary.
issue_context.analysis: The public linked implementation and release provide concrete coverage; a new independent design would duplicate the merged work.
initial_investigation: Read the issue and all four comments.
Inspected merged PR 49414 metadata and changed-file list.
Reviewed the current version-helper change path and searched for duplicate reports.

actions.label: Close as handled by merged version parsing

comment.body: Thanks for the reproduction details and screenshot. The reported four-component release-version parsing path is covered by merged PR #49414, which updated the shared version helper and its native regression tests. The corresponding v0.101.2362.0 release is published. This can be closed as handled; if an affected supported installation still cannot update after Store propagation, please open a focused follow-up with its exact installed version and update result.
